documents.title: Roadside assistance triage
documents.content: Collect the contract number, customer callback number, exact vehicle location, safety conditions, and vehicle symptoms. Mark cases involving injury, danger, or an immobilized customer as urgent.

documents.title: Regional escalation matrix
documents.content: Escalate unresolved roadside cases to the regional assistance queue. A supervisor reviews cases that exceed the response target or require a replacement vehicle.

documents.title: Service recovery guidance
documents.content: Acknowledge the customer’s experience, summarize the next action, set a callback expectation, and record the case outcome in the support timeline.

documents.title: Customer data handling
documents.content: Use contract and case identifiers in internal notes. Do not include unnecessary payment details, identity documents, or unrelated personal information in a support response.

documents.title: Callback commitment standard
documents.content: When a callback is promised, record the target time, responsible queue, preferred contact channel, and a concise summary of the customer’s requested outcome.

documents.title: Replacement vehicle request
documents.content: Confirm vehicle immobility, passenger safety, location, contract status, and destination branch before requesting a replacement vehicle through the regional assistance queue.
